Chernozhukov et al. Double/debiased machine learning for treatment and structural parameters, exact original/author-hosted published or explicitly versioned arXiv body; orthogonal scores, cross-fitting, product-rate and variance conditions.

Benjamini-Hochberg1995 original FDR paper, with a primary Benjamini-Yekutieli2001 extension only if required for an intended dependence claim. Identify precise null-uniformity/independence or dependence assumptions and separate FDR from familywise control.
